Standard: Any systems on the air vehicle (including but not limited to emitting equipment, defensive systems, and weapons), which if active during the AR process, could create a hazard to the targeted air vehicle or to the crewmembers of the targeted air vehicle, can be individually inhibited or disabled prior to entering the AR process. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examination of specifications and system design shows systems that could create a hazard to targeted air vehicles can be individually inhibited during AR. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Laboratory test verifies systems can be individually inhibited. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Flight testing verifies systems can be individually inhibited prior to AR operations.
